description: This Java source file defines the IncomingRequestWearService class, which extends WearableListenerService to handle incoming messages and requests related to sensor permissions and data from a paired phone device in an Android Wear OS application.

classes.name: IncomingRequestWearService
classes.description: A service that listens for incoming messages from a paired device and responds with sensor data or permission prompts.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service and logs creation.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, parses request type, and triggers permission prompt or data response.

methods.name: promptUserForSensorPermission
methods.description: Checks sensor permission; if granted, sends approval message; otherwise, launches permission activity.

methods.name: respondWithSensorInformation
methods.description: Checks sensor permission; if granted, retrieves sensor info and sends it; otherwise, requests permission.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Establishes GoogleApiClient connection, finds the best node, and sends a message with data.

methods.name: pickBestNodeId
methods.description: Selects the most appropriate node (preferably nearby) from a set of nodes.
